plain: A person or group that acts in place of another

webster.text: The agency of another who acts as a substitute for his principal; agency of a substitute; appearance of a representative.

more.text: The person who is substituted or deputed to act for another.

example.quote: It is ordained and established by the people themselves ; and we, who give our votes for it, are merely the proxies of our constituents.
example.cite: Jonathan Elliot, ed., The Debates in the Several State Conventions on the Adoption of the Federal Constitution, vol. 2, Pennsylvania Convention, Mr. WILSON, December 11, 1787 and the following sittings (Elliot prints no later date headings) (2d ed. 1836)
